_doc: Hard blocks the tools enforce, one switch each. Separate from self-governance levels (governance.json): a level says who decides; a guardrail is a stop that holds whatever anyone decides. Read through co.guard(name) (company/tools/lib/company.js): true = the block is ON. Changed only by the owner (node company/tools/guardrails.js set|off-all|on-all --by <owner>), every change logged and watched by locked-watch.js while that guardrail itself is on. Turning a guardrail off is meant for experiments, ideally in a disposable container: set `sandbox` true to record that the station runs isolated; guardrails.js warns loudly when guardrails are off and sandbox is false.

_guards.ownerGates: the four owner gates (access, ownership, commitment, spend beyond the cap) always need the owner, whatever the governance levels say. Off: governance levels alone decide.
_guards.spendCap: metered spend stops at the daily cap and per-agent shares (dispatch-budget.json) and subscriptions at their pacing line. Off: no cap holds a run.
_guards.externalActions: nothing leaves the company (message, publish, account, form, spend, network) without a clearance row (external-gate.js). Off: the gate logs but allows.
_guards.harnessSelfEdit: agents cannot change their own harness: locked files (policy, gates, keys, StarNet code, routine prompts' owner fields) are watched and put back (locked-watch.js); tool changes go through review (harness-change.js). Off: agents may edit any of it; changes are still logged.
_guards.defaultBranch: no agent pushes or merges to a repository's default branch without the merge gate (merge-gate.js, default-branch-watch.js). Off: agents push freely.
_guards.secrets: agents never read, print or copy secrets/ or the station key store. Off: agents may read keys (they still are never printed to the owner channel).
_guards.localComputer: agents work only inside the station workspace and blessed project folders; computer control (screen and keyboard) stays off. Off: full file system and computer control.
_guards.privilegedShell: sudo only through the sudo gate's allowlist (sudo-gate/). Off: the gate passes sudo through.
_guards.promptInjection: the station's injection tripwire refuses routines and inputs carrying override or exfiltration payloads. Off: tripwire logs only.
_guards.halt: soft and hard halt work and a halted company starts nothing. This one cannot be turned off.
